scenario: [LUNI.8.4]: an author who wants the raw numeric result strips the units on the operands first, and may assert a unit on the result: `(r.w::Float * r.h::Float)::meter_squared`. Pin: the program compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.types.luni_8_1_combine`'s bare arm over two strips, and the `Float -> <unit>` cast in `dsc.cast`.
rules_ds:
unit dimension area storage float64 base meter_squared
unit meter_squared: area

schema Rect scope logical:
    id: Int key
    w: meter mutable
    h: meter mutable

rule r:
    Rect s where (s.w::Float * s.h::Float)::meter_squared > 1_meter_squared
->
    log info "x"
